learning_outcomes.text: Address common questions students have about entering the professional world, such as job search strategies, resume writing, interview skills, and the importance of master's degrees.
Understand the additional skills required beyond academic knowledge, including fluent English, technical and general software proficiency (spreadsheets, presentations), and useful soft skills.
Gain clarity on the tasks performed within various company departments, including product-related issues, plant management, and distribution logistics, and the relationships with other professionals.
Introduce students to the professional world and the sectors in which companies operate, facilitating training, internships, and work placements.
Learn about job opportunities and internationalization programs.

assessment_rules: The final assessment is a final judgment, not a numerical grade.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica (Mechanical Engineering), classe L-9 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria industriale
